entries.title: I Chronicles 2:1
segments: ¶These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:2
segments: Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:3
segments: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah: [which] three were born to him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and he slew him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:4
segments: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Pherez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:5
segments: The sons of Pherez: Hezron and Hamul.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:6
segments: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:7
segments: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the accursed thing.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:8
segments: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:9
segments: And the sons of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:10
segments: And Ram begot Amminadab; and Amminadab begot Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:11
segments: and Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:12
segments: and Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:13
segments: and Jesse begot his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:14
segments: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:15
segments: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:16
segments: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:17
segments: And Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:18
segments: ¶And Caleb the son of Hezron had children by Azubah [his] wife, and by Jerioth: her sons are these: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:19
segments: And Azubah died, and Caleb took him Ephrath, and she bore him Hur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:20
segments: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezaleel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:21
segments: And afterwards Hezron went to the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, and he took her when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:22
segments: And Segub begot Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:23
segments: and Geshur and Aram took the villages of Jair from them, with Kenath and its dependent towns, sixty cities. All these were sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:24
segments: And after the death of Hezron in Caleb-Ephratah, Abijah, Hezron's wife, bore him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:25
segments: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were: Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, of Ahijah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:26
segments: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:27
segments: And the sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:28
segments: And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:29
segments: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:30
segments: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; and Seled died without sons.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:31
segments: And the sons of Appaim: Jishi; and the sons of Jishi: Sheshan; and the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:32
segments: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without sons.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:33
segments: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:34
segments: And Sheshan had no sons, but daughters; and Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:35
segments: and Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife, and she bore him Attai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:36
segments: And Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:37
segments: and Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:38
segments: and Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:39
segments: and Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Elasah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:40
segments: and Elasah begot Sismai, and Sismai begot Shallum,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:41
segments: and Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:42
segments: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:43
segments: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:44
segments: And Shema begot Raham, the father of Jorkeam. And Rekem begot Shammai;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:45
segments: and the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:46
segments: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:47
segments: And the sons of Jehdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:48
segments: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:49
segments: and she bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:50
segments: These are the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah: Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:51
segments: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:52
segments: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, Hazi-Hammenuhoth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:53
segments: And the families of Kirjath-jearim were the Jithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zoreathites and the Eshtaolites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:54
segments: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, and the Netophathites. Atroth-Beth-Joab, and the Hazi-Hammana-hethites, the Zorites;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:55
segments: and the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez: the Tireathites, the Shimeathites, the Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
